newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Gruma downgraded to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gruma downgraded to neutral.

text.p: Abaco Grupo Financiero said on Tuesday that it had downgraded Gruma SA to neutral from long-term buy.
-- Abaco said that the downgrade was due to the uncertain future of subsidiary, Grupo Industrial Maseca, which provides 52 percent of total group revenue.
-- "For 1997, Gruma's results will be negatively affected by Maseca, as maximum subsidized tons were not modified by the government," Abaco said.

-- "This will provoke lower complementary revenue, higher corn costs and lower margins. Even if Gruma Corp, and Gruma Centroamerica improve their profitability, (by 1 to 1.5 percentage points), Maseca could seriously affect Gruma's consolidated margin," it said in the report.
